tools_and_strategies.paper: LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (NeurIPS 2023)
tools_and_strategies.description: Open-source tool for theorem proving in Lean using retrieval-augmented language models. Removes barriers to research on ML methods for theorem proving.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Uses dense text embeddings + graph neural networks over heterogeneous dependency graph capturing state-premise and premise-premise relations.

tools_and_strategies.paper: An In-Context Learning Agent for Formal Theorem-Proving
tools_and_strategies.description: In-context learning agent that repeatedly asks GPT-4 to propose tactic applications from within the proof context, using Lean/Coq environment feedback.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Uses GPT-4 with in-context learning, leveraging proof assistant feedback to guide tactic selection without fine-tuning.

tools_and_strategies.paper: DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5: Harnessing Proof Assistant Feedback for RL and MCTS
tools_and_strategies.description: Open-source language model for theorem proving in Lean 4, optimizing both training and inference with proof assistant feedback.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning and Monte Carlo Tree Search for efficient proof exploration.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Long-horizon autoformalization of a core theorem underlying MIP* = RE
tools_and_strategies.description: System that coordinates AI proving agents under human supervision to address statement drift and proof composition in long-horizon formalization. Completed 126,367 lines of Lean 4 code for MIP* = RE core theorem.

applicability_to_omni_hub.T-THEO-0002: CRITICAL - Directly applicable to MIP* consistency proofs

tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Uses shared blueprint to guide nested planning, proving and review loops. Agents strengthen verification and review throughout formalization.

tools_and_strategies.paper: BFS-Prover: Scalable Best-First Tree Search for LLM-based Automatic Theorem Proving
tools_and_strategies.description: Scalable best-first tree search for LLM-based automatic theorem proving, achieving state-of-the-art results on miniF2F benchmark.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Best-first search with learned value function to guide proof exploration, scaling to large proof spaces efficiently.

tools_and_strategies.paper: HunyuanProver: A Scalable Data Synthesis Framework and Guided Tree Search
tools_and_strategies.description: Language model finetuned from Hunyuan 7B for interactive automatic theorem proving with scalable data synthesis.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Uses scalable data synthesis and guided tree search for efficient proof exploration.

tools_and_strategies.paper: LongCat-Flash-Prover: Advancing Native Formal Reasoning via Agentic TIR
tools_and_strategies.description: 560B-parameter open-source MoE model advancing native formal reasoning in Lean 4 through agentic tool-integrated reasoning (TIR).
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Decomposes native formal reasoning into auto-formalization, sketching, and proving through agentic tool-integrated reasoning.

tools_and_strategies.paper: MA-LoT: Model-Collaboration Lean-based Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
tools_and_strategies.description: Framework that uses multiple models to either write a complete proof or perform tree search, balancing these tasks for Lean 4 theorem proving.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Model collaboration with long chain-of-thought reasoning for complex proof tasks.

tools_and_strategies.paper: MerLean-Prover: A Recursive Looping Harness for Lean 4 Theorem Proving
tools_and_strategies.description: End-to-end Lean 4 theorem proving system with recursive looping harness for automated proof generation.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Recursive looping harness for end-to-end theorem proving in Lean 4.

tools_and_strategies.paper: LeanProgress: Guiding Search for Neural Theorem Proving via Proof Progress Prediction
tools_and_strategies.description: Guides search for neural theorem proving by predicting proof progress, helping LLMs navigate long proofs and complex mathematics.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Predicts proof progress to guide search, avoiding dead ends in proof exploration.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Seed-Prover 1.5: Mastering Undergraduate-Level Theorem Proving via Learning from Experience
tools_and_strategies.description: LLM-based theorem prover that learns from experience to master undergraduate-level theorem proving.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Learns from successful proof attempts to improve future theorem proving.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Goedel-Architect: Streamlining Formal Theorem Proving with Blueprint Generation
tools_and_strategies.description: Agentic framework for formal theorem proving centered on blueprint generation and refinement. Creates dependency graphs of definitions and lemmas.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Generates blueprints (dependency graphs) of definitions and lemmas, then refines them into complete proofs.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Pythagoras-Prover: Advancing Efficient Formal Proving via Augmented Lean Formalisation
tools_and_strategies.description: Efficient formal proving via augmented Lean formalisation, improving proof automation.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Augments Lean formalisation with additional structure for efficient proof search.

tools_and_strategies.paper: STP: Self-play LLM Theorem Provers with Iterative Conjecturing and Proving
tools_and_strategies.description: Self-play LLM theorem provers that alternate between generating proofs and conjecturing new theorems, addressing data scarcity.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Alternates between LLM generating proofs and finetuning on correctly generated ones, with iterative conjecturing.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Reward-Oracle MCTS for Formal Theorem Proving: Sample-Efficient Search
tools_and_strategies.description: Three-role MCTS framework that treats Lean 4 compiler purely as reward oracle using compiler output as scalar signal for UCB-guided tree updates.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Uses compiler as reward oracle without feeding error content into generation context, enabling sample-efficient search.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Process-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Theorem Proving via Lean
tools_and_strategies.description: Uses Lean proof assistant as symbolic process oracle, supplying both outcome-level and fine-grained tactic-level verified feedback during training.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Lean serves as symbolic process oracle with dense, sound feedback during training.

tools_and_strategies.paper: ProofBridge: Auto-Formalization of Natural Language Proofs in Lean via Joint Embeddings
tools_and_strategies.description: Translates human-written mathematical theorems and proofs from natural language into Lean 4 formal language via joint embeddings.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Joint embeddings of natural language and formal language for autoformalization.

tools_and_strategies.paper: DRIFT: Decompose, Retrieve, Illustrate, then Formalize Theorems
tools_and_strategies.description: Framework for autoformalization that decomposes theorems, retrieves relevant knowledge, illustrates with examples, then formalizes.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Four-stage pipeline: Decompose -> Retrieve -> Illustrate -> Formalize.

tools_and_strategies.paper: TheoremBench: Evaluating LLMs on Theorem Proving in Formal Mathematics
tools_and_strategies.description: Lean 4 benchmark for evaluating theorem provers beyond contest settings, with nearly 100 classical theorems in plain and premised versions.

tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Premised version expands theorems into structured families of related proving tasks with automatically extracted supporting subtheorems.

tools_and_strategies.paper: LeanCat: A Benchmark Suite for Formal Category Theory in Lean
tools_and_strategies.description: Benchmark for library-grounded abstraction in formal category theory, measuring ability to reason with high-level interfaces.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Measures library-grounded abstraction - reasoning with high-level interfaces and reusable structures.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Pantograph: A Machine-to-Machine Interaction Interface for Advanced Theorem Proving in Lean 4
tools_and_strategies.description: Versatile interface to Lean 4 proof assistant enabling efficient proof search, high-level reasoning, and data extraction.

applicability_to_omni_hub.ALL: Infrastructure for integrating ML models with Lean 4

tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Provides machine-to-machine interaction interface for Lean 4, enabling integration with ML models.

tools_and_strategies.paper: Nazrin: An Atomic Neural Proof Automation Tactic in Lean 4
tools_and_strategies.description: Atomic neural proof automation tactic in Lean 4 for machine-assisted theorem proving.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Atomic neural tactic for proof automation in Lean 4.

tools_and_strategies.paper: TorchLean: Formalizing Neural Networks in Lean
tools_and_strategies.description: Unified framework for formalizing, executing, and verifying neural networks in Lean 4.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Treats neural networks as formal objects in Lean 4 for verification.

tools_and_strategies.paper: ITPEval: Benchmarking Formal Translation Across Interactive Theorem Provers
tools_and_strategies.description: First benchmark for evaluating automated formal translation across incompatible theorem prover systems.
tools_and_strategies.technical_details: Evaluates translation between Coq, Lean, Isabelle/HOL, and other systems.
